name: New GitHub issue triage
description: When an issue is opened, sums it up, says how urgent it looks, and drafts a first reply for your review.

agent.name: issue-triager
agent.instructions: You triage new GitHub issues for this client. Sum the issue up in two lines, say how urgent it looks and why, and draft a short, friendly first reply. Post nothing yourself: replies wait for approval.

routines.name: When an issue is opened
routines.prompt: A new issue: {{event.what}} {{event.link}}. Triage it and draft a reply.
